## Implementation progress under ruling 5978140439

The bounded fork-chat repair is implemented locally in G's #2555 worktree.
It is not a final-head proof audit or a claim that the complete 48-row class is
closed. No production push or compensation cherry-pick was made.

- Mock model/tool and Claude fork-state callers share the existing workspace
  owner's exact isolated target projection. Snapshot source identity remains
  provenance; no source container, live data or provider backing is mounted.
- The selected-store effect owner provides read-only exact prepared/executing
  fork-turn currency. Ordinary executable admission remains executing-only.
  Terminal groups refuse cleanly; observation creates no provider attempt.
- Foreign named targets cannot use ordinary stale-workspace replacement.
  Partial start and refusal cleanup are identity-checked and joined.

**Passed WIP proof:**

1. SQLite and PostgreSQL public host and real-Docker fork/chat, continuation,
   keyed replay, stale-authority refusal and clean new-request retry.
2. Actual Docker gateway disconnect before model: matching public/durable typed
   refusal, terminal occurrence, zero completions, no keyed redispatch, exact
   sandbox cleanup and successful later continuation.
3. Source container ID, labels, sentinel file, running state, exact lifecycle
   identity/epoch/generation/config/topology/process binding and session survive.
   A later public source directive succeeds through the real MCP transport.
   Snapshot reads and stubbed emits create no live domain mutation.
4. Workspace owner fault matrix under race x3: missing/malformed/expired/
   mismatched/foreign authority, conflicting named target and partial start.
5. Offline real-Docker Claude state retention/isolation/continuation control
   with synthetic transcripts and network none; normal provider state survives.
6. Real-Docker interpreter cancellation and an actually held HTTP list request
   both join the native worker; HTTP deadline cancels the real request.
7. Crossed mock/descriptor/authority/settlement/retained-restart controls and
   the complete API specification package; `git diff --check`.

Receipts are retained at `worktrees/agent-g-2555-evidence/`; exact test names and
limits are recorded in the checked-in audit's progress section. Docker used an
explicit bridge on server2: this is hardened-host transport proof, not the
pending hosted implicit-Linux default acceptance. The served proof is internal
H composition exposing public RPC, not public mock-under-serve or paid-provider
credit. No real Telegram message or successful paid Claude call was made.

**Still open:** the remaining original temporal/multi-context/complete retained
crash rows, hosted default-Docker acceptance, clean-head full/full qualification
and final PR audit. L01/L04 and final closure additionally require #2525's actual
merge and G's exact both-store activation-refusal/retry proof. #2525 remains open
at a9ba49485; its `self_release` / `start_failed` compensation is E-owned and
untouched here. I am not claiming that #2525 is the sole remaining work item.
